STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_1_DESC.english:
Shugo Trade Charter

Requirement: Season Pass Premium, purchased with Kinah.
Duration: Until the season ends.

Benefits
+30% XP from hunting, groups, quests, gathering and crafting.
+30% gathering and crafting skill XP.
Central Market: receive 84.5% of each sale instead of 65%.
Wardrobe: unlock appearances without a ticket.
STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_1_DESC.chinese:
术古贸易特许状

获取条件：使用基纳购买赛季通行证高级版。
有效期：截至本赛季结束。

增益效果
狩猎、组队、任务、采集和制作获得的经验值 +30%。
采集和制作技能经验值 +30%。
中央市场：每笔成交可获得售价的 84.5%，原为 65%。
衣柜：无需解锁券即可解锁外观。

STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_2_DESC.english:
Grace of the Tower

Requirement: Season Pass Advanced Premium.
Duration: Until the season ends.

Benefits
+20% item drops.
Energy of Repose: full refill after 24 hours offline instead of 48.
Central Market warehouse: +2,000 VT capacity.
STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_2_DESC.chinese:
高塔恩泽

获取条件：获得赛季通行证进阶高级版。
有效期：截至本赛季结束。

增益效果
物品掉落率 +20%。
休息之气息：离线回满所需时间由 48 小时缩短至 24 小时。
中央市场仓库容量 +2,000 VT。

STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_3_DESC.english:
Aetherfall Renown

Account Fame is shared by your characters. Open Account Window to see your current points and reward steps.

Earning Fame
Combat: character levels from level 10. Levels 55+ count double; level 65 counts five times.
Life: gathering and crafting skills from 100; one Fame per five skill points.
Legend: one Fame per ten completed quests, plus five per title.

Daily Kinah mail
100 Kinah per Fame point, with separate daily limits:
Combat: 500,000 Kinah. Life: 250,000. Legend: 250,000.

Combat Fame rewards: bonus Abyss Points
200 Fame: +10%. 500: +20%. 1,000: +30%.
2,000 Fame: +40%. 3,000: +50%.

Life Fame rewards: crafting / gathering skill XP
50 Fame: +50% / +0%.
100 Fame: +100% / +100%.
200 Fame: +200% / +100%.
400 Fame: +300% / +200%.
800 Fame: +500% / +200%.

Legend Fame rewards: Energy of Repose XP bonus
50 Fame: 50%. 100: 60%. 200: 70%.
300 Fame: 80%. 400: 100%.

Total Fame rewards
1,000 Fame: Central Market sales return 5% more.
2,500 Fame: +10% item drops.
STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_3_DESC.chinese:
Aetherfall 声望

账号下的角色共享名望。打开账号面板，可查看当前点数和各档奖励。

如何获得名望
战斗：从角色 10 级开始计算。55 级起按双倍计算，65 级按五倍计算。
生活：采集和制作技能从 100 点开始计算，每 5 点技能点获得 1 点名望。
传奇：每完成 10 个任务获得 1 点名望，每获得一个称号额外获得 5 点。

每日基纳邮件
每点名望发放 100 基纳，各类名望的每日上限分别为：
战斗 500,000 基纳，生活 250,000 基纳，传奇 250,000 基纳。

战斗名望奖励：额外欧比斯点数
200 点：+10%。500 点：+20%。1,000 点：+30%。
2,000 点：+40%。3,000 点：+50%。

生活名望奖励：制作／采集技能经验值
50 点：+50%／+0%。
100 点：+100%／+100%。
200 点：+200%／+100%。
400 点：+300%／+200%。
800 点：+500%／+200%。

传奇名望奖励：休息之气息经验值加成
50 点：50%。100 点：60%。200 点：70%。
300 点：80%。400 点：100%。

总名望奖励
1,000 点：中央市场成交所得增加 5%。
2,500 点：物品掉落率 +10%。

STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_4_DESC.english:
Chronicle of Atreia

Permanent account bonuses earned through story and quest progress on any character.

Chapters
Complete the Ascension ceremony.
Enter the Abyss.
Complete The Unfinished Entry.
Complete 300 quests.
Complete 800 quests.

Benefits for each chapter
+3% maximum HP and MP.
+2% physical attack.
+20 magic boost.
+3% physical defence.
+10 magic resist.
STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_4_DESC.chinese:
亚特雷亚编年史

账号下任一角色推进剧情和任务，均可获得永久账号增益。

章节
完成守护者仪式。
进入欧比斯。
完成《未完的记录》。
完成 300 个任务。
完成 800 个任务。

每章奖励
最大生命力和精神力 +3%。
物理攻击力 +2%。
魔法增幅力 +20。
物理防御力 +3%。
魔法抵抗 +10。

STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_5_DESC.english:
Daeva Veteran's Coffer

Requirement: A level 65 Daeva on your account.

Receive a coffer by mail for every month of account age.
Rewards include expansion tickets, enchantment stones, crafting charms, mounts and more.
The timer shows when the next coffer is due.
STR_F2P_PACK_PACK_5_DESC.chinese:
资深守护者宝箱

获取条件：账号下有一名 65 级守护者。

账号每满一个月，便会通过邮件收到一个宝箱。
奖励包括扩展券、强化石、制作护符、坐骑等。
计时器显示下一个宝箱的发放时间。

STR_DIC_N_Spatalos.english: Spatalos;The Brigade General of [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]. He lost his wife and son in the Krall War, and has become correspondingly ruthless in his pursuit of victory.
STR_DIC_N_Spatalos.chinese: 斯帕塔洛斯;[%dic:STR_DIC_FLA09]的军团长。他的妻儿在克拉尔战争中丧生，此后他为求胜利变得愈发冷酷。

STR_DIC_N_Gano.english: Gano;He gathers herbs near [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA24]. He used to live in [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA27] but moved to [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10] after he became homesickness. He likes children, and often takes care of Perinens' kids, Serin and Polor.
STR_DIC_N_Gano.chinese: 加诺;他在[%dic:STR_DIC_FLA24]附近采集药草。原先住在[%dic:STR_DIC_FLA27]，后来因为想家搬到了[%dic:STR_DIC_FLA10]。他喜欢孩子，经常照看佩里内斯家的塞林和波洛。

STR_DIC_N_Gogohas.english: Geolus;An Ecologist at the [%dic:STR_DIC_FLA15] in Verteron. He is researching the contamination of the forest, along with his assistant [%dic:STR_DIC_LA160].
STR_DIC_N_Gogohas.chinese: 古古哈斯;在贝尔特伦的[%dic:STR_DIC_FLA15]工作的生态学家，正与助手[%dic:STR_DIC_LA160]一同调查森林受污染的原因。

STR_WARDROBE_APPEARANCE_UNLOCK_DESC.english: Unlocks one equipment appearance for your account in Wardrobe. Keeps the equipment. Unlocked skins can be applied without another material.
STR_WARDROBE_APPEARANCE_UNLOCK_DESC.chinese: 在衣柜中为整个账号解锁一款装备外观，原装备会保留。应用已解锁的外观无需额外材料。

STR_WARDROBE_AETHER_PALETTE_DESC.english: Opens every dye color in the Wardrobe palette for your whole account. Open Wardrobe, choose Dyes, then Unlock Palette. Palette dyes are free and unlimited.
STR_WARDROBE_AETHER_PALETTE_DESC.chinese: 为整个账号解锁衣柜调色盘中的全部染色颜色。打开衣柜，选择“染色”，再点击“解锁调色盘”。调色盘中的颜色可免费染色，次数不限。

STR_QUEST_14983A_DESC.english: A crude wax impression recovered from the stolen Tolbas goods. A nick in its rim may reveal how the false escort orders were made. Bring it to Santenius in Tolbas Village.
STR_QUEST_14983A_DESC.chinese: 从托尔巴斯的失窃物品中找回的粗糙蜡模。边缘的一处缺口或许能揭示假护送令的来历。请把它交给托尔巴斯村的山特尼乌斯。

STR_QUEST_14987A_DESC.english: A damaged swamp root coated with loose, pale grit. Bring this sample to Lepios so he can distinguish the cargo residue from the swamp's existing contamination.
STR_QUEST_14987A_DESC.chinese: 一截受损的沼泽根须，表面附有松散的浅色砂砾。请将样本交给莱费奥斯，以便辨别货物残渣与沼泽原有的污染。

STR_QUEST_14988A_DESC.english: Loose pale grit recovered beside an intact Mysterious Stone. Show it to Meliodas and bring it to Ibion at Pilgrims Respite.
STR_QUEST_14988A_DESC.chinese: 在一块完好的神秘石旁采集的松散浅色砂砾。先给梅里奥达斯看看，再带给巡礼者休息处的伊比温。

STR_QUEST_14990A_DESC.english: A cargo packet bearing three cut marks, repacked among Krall supplies. Bring it to Meteina as evidence of the transfer point.
STR_QUEST_14990A_DESC.chinese: 一包带有三道刻痕的货物，被重新包好后混在克拉尔的补给中。请把它交给梅泰娜，作为货物在此交接的证据。

STR_QUEST_14992A_DESC.english: A dust-stiffened packet carrying cargo marks and watch-change delivery instructions. Bring it to Une on Cantas Coast.
STR_QUEST_14992A_DESC.chinese: 包裹被积尘结得发硬，上面有货物标记和要求在换岗时交货的指示。请将它带给坎塔斯海岸的乌内。

STR_AETHERFALL_HELP_PROGRESS.english: Join the requesting companion through Find Group. Confirmed objectives appear here.
STR_AETHERFALL_HELP_PROGRESS.chinese: 通过「寻找队伍」加入发出求助的伙伴。确认后的目标会显示在这里。

STR_AETHERFALL_ROAD_BOUNTY_PROGRESS.english: Defeat 15 XP-eligible monsters on the road where you accepted the bounty.
STR_AETHERFALL_ROAD_BOUNTY_PROGRESS.chinese: 在接取悬赏的路线沿途，击败 15 只可提供经验值的怪物。

STR_AETHERFALL_HELP_PROGRESS_2.english: Join the requesting companion through Find Group. Confirmed objectives appear here.
STR_AETHERFALL_HELP_PROGRESS_2.chinese: 通过「寻找队伍」加入发出求助的伙伴。确认后的目标会显示在这里。

STR_AETHERFALL_HELP_PROGRESS_3.english: Join the requesting companion through Find Group. Confirmed objectives appear here.
STR_AETHERFALL_HELP_PROGRESS_3.chinese: 通过「寻找队伍」加入发出求助的伙伴。确认后的目标会显示在这里。

STR_PRIVATE_AETHERFALL_PANEL_SUBTITLE.chinese: 天魔两族，同在亚特雷亚

STR_PRIVATE_AETHERFALL_BODY_0.english: Build your party. Recruit companions and choose how they fight beside you.
STR_PRIVATE_AETHERFALL_BODY_0.chinese: 招募伙伴，组建队伍，并为他们安排战斗分工。

STR_PRIVATE_AETHERFALL_BODY_1.english: Discover Poeta or Ishalgen, follow their stories, and explore the world beyond.
STR_PRIVATE_AETHERFALL_BODY_1.chinese: 从普埃塔或伊斯夏尔肯出发，沿着各自的故事探索更广阔的世界。

STR_PRIVATE_AETHERFALL_BODY_2.english: Gather your allies, face challenging encounters, and discover the mysteries of Atreia.
STR_PRIVATE_AETHERFALL_BODY_2.chinese: 召集伙伴，挑战强敌，揭开亚特雷亚的秘密。

STR_AETHERFALL_LOOT_NEED_HELP.english: Need: roll for an item your character can use. Need rolls take priority over Greed.
STR_AETHERFALL_LOOT_NEED_HELP.chinese: 需求：为当前角色能使用的物品掷骰。选择需求的玩家优先获得物品。

STR_AETHERFALL_LOOT_GREED_HELP.english: Greed: roll if nobody needs this item.
STR_AETHERFALL_LOOT_GREED_HELP.chinese: 贪婪：无人选择需求时，参与掷骰。

STR_AETHERFALL_LOOT_PASS_HELP.english: Pass: leave this item for the other eligible players.
STR_AETHERFALL_LOOT_PASS_HELP.chinese: 放弃：将物品留给其他有拾取资格的玩家。

STR_AETHERFALL_ACCOUNT_WINDOW_HELP.english: Open your Aetherfall Account: boons, renown and characters
STR_AETHERFALL_ACCOUNT_WINDOW_HELP.chinese: 查看 Aetherfall 账号的增益、名望和角色。

STR_AETHERFALL_ACCOUNT_DETAILS.english: Select an account boon to read its details.
STR_AETHERFALL_ACCOUNT_DETAILS.chinese: 选择一项账号增益查看详情。

STR_AETHERFALL_CODEX_MAP_HELP.english: Codex: search items and creatures beside the map; select a spawn area to show it on the map
STR_AETHERFALL_CODEX_MAP_HELP.chinese: 在地图旁的图鉴中搜索物品或怪物。选择一处出没区域即可在地图上标出。

STR_AETHERFALL_CODEX_TARGET_HELP.english: Codex: this creature's loot and spawn areas
STR_AETHERFALL_CODEX_TARGET_HELP.chinese: 在图鉴中查看该怪物的掉落物和出没区域。

STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_1.english: Invite or Apply shows the price and term before Yes.
STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_1.chinese: 点击「邀请」或「申请」后，先查看费用和雇佣时长，再确认。

STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_2.english: One payment in Kinah to this helper.
STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_2.chinese: 以基纳一次性向这位帮手支付雇佣费。

STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_3.english: The term starts on joining and does not renew.
STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_3.chinese: 帮手加入队伍时开始计时，到期后不会自动续约。

STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_4.english: Disconnecting, dismissal or leaving the party ends it.
STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_4.chinese: 断线、解雇或离队都会结束雇佣。

STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_5.english: There is no refund after the helper joins.
STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_5.chinese: 帮手加入队伍后，雇佣费不予退还。

STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_6.english: Choosing No, expiry or a failed join costs nothing.
STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_6.chinese: 取消、邀请超时或加入失败均不扣费。

STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_7.english: The helper keeps its own items and earnings.
STR_AETHERFALL_HIRE_TERM_7.chinese: 帮手保留自己的物品和收益。
